cases.title: An ordinary note
cases.description: A short, ordinary text note with no known indicators.

cases.title: A quoted override phrase

cases.title: A look-alike text message
cases.description: The same override sent as an SMS with a Cyrillic letter in place of one Latin letter. The scanner folds look-alikes, so the message is still held.

cases.title: A request for secrets

cases.title: An HTML-encoded phrase
cases.description: An inert override phrase containing an HTML character reference. Its finding belongs to a decoded view.

agent-ingest.policy_reason: agent-ingest holds advisory and note findings

cases.title: An instruction hidden in a web page
cases.description: A synced page whose override sentence is styled invisible. Hidden instructions are held under every agent policy, including the document policy.

agent-ingest.policy_reason: agent-ingest holds advisory and note findings

cases.title: A Word file with a split sentence
cases.description: An override sentence Word stored across three formatting runs. The joined text is scanned, so it is found; the document policy records it as a note.

agent-ingest.policy_reason: agent-ingest holds advisory and note findings

cases.title: A base64 field in a tool result
cases.description: A JSON tool result whose base64 field decodes to a reworded override, with no fixed phrase to match. Each base64 run is decoded and read by the phrase rules.

agent-ingest.policy_reason: agent-ingest holds advisory and note findings

cases.title: Ordinary base64 in a tool result
cases.description: The same tool result carrying a session token, a PNG thumbnail, and a base64 note that decodes to an ordinary sentence. Everything is decoded; nothing matches.

cases.title: A PDF that hides its text in glyph ids
cases.description: A browser-style PDF that stores text as font glyph numbers, with one word in bold so the sentence spans three text objects. The text is read through the font's ToUnicode map and the paragraph is rejoined.

agent-ingest.policy_reason: agent-ingest holds advisory and note findings

cases.title: The same PDF with an ordinary sentence
cases.description: Identical fonts, glyph encoding, and bold-word layout, with a sentence that asks the reader to review the attached guidelines.

cases.title: A model checkpoint that runs a command
cases.description: A torch-style zip whose pickle first builds ordinary state (a dict, a set, a big integer), then calls os.system. The opcodes are walked without unpickling.

cases.title: An ordinary model checkpoint
cases.description: The same checkpoint state rebuilt through collections.OrderedDict, the way saved models normally load. No dangerous callable is named.

cases.title: A dev container that runs a download on the host
cases.description: A synced repository whose devcontainer.json downloads and runs a script in initializeCommand, which runs on the host before the container exists.

agent-ingest.policy_reason: agent-ingest holds advisory and note findings

cases.title: An ordinary dev container
cases.description: A host command that only creates a folder, and installers (npm ci, uv sync) that run inside the container, where they are expected.

cases.title: An executable named as a PDF
cases.description: A tiny synthetic executable header given a document name. The example is inspected as bytes, never run.

cases.title: A rule compilation failure
cases.description: An ordinary note scanned with a deliberately broken local rule. The failed scan stays held.
